title: Chicken Joo is online. Get 25% off your website order.
excerpt: Celebrate our website launch with 25% off your total website order, with no minimum spend. September 15–October 15, 2026, at all Chicken Joo branches.
body: Chicken Joo’s website is here. Explore chicken meals, sharing boxes, and sides, then choose the flavors for your next chicken break.
To celebrate the website launch, get 25% off your total website order from September 15 to October 15, 2026. There is no minimum spend, and all Chicken Joo branches are participating.
Choose your meal and flavors, add your selections to the cart, and review your pickup details. The launch voucher will show your savings before you save an eligible order.

The launch voucher allows one redemption per customer account. Sign in or create an account when adding your meal to the cart. Its use is recorded securely after an eligible order is successfully saved.
See your chosen branch’s details to plan your pickup. For general questions about the website launch, contact Chicken Joo at jooservice@chickenjoo.com or 0976 200 2000.
